title: Passage 15
voice: 温暖自然英式女老师｜IndexTTS2.5 慢速教学

sentences.en: Last year I had a trip with my friend Nancy.
sentences.cn: 去年，我和朋友南希去旅行。

sentences.en: We enjoyed sandwiches and shared a jar of honey tea over lunch.
sentences.cn: 午餐时，我们吃了三明治，还分享了一罐蜂蜜茶。

sentences.en: The weather was cloudy except for one night.
sentences.cn: 天气多云，只有一个晚上例外。

sentences.en: Wearing comfortable skirts, Nancy and I camped in the field after dinner.
sentences.cn: 晚饭后，我和南希穿着舒适的裙子在野外露营。

sentences.en: I listened to her playing the guitar and we felt relaxed.
sentences.cn: 我听她弹吉他，我们都感到很放松。

sentences.en: Looking at the stars, we started a hunt for the brightest one.
sentences.cn: 看着满天繁星，我们开始寻找最亮的那一颗。

sentences.en: 'It's a pity we don't know which stars we're looking at, Jenny,' said Nancy.
sentences.cn: 南希说：“珍妮，真可惜我们不知道我们看到的是哪些星星。”

sentences.en: 'I know some of them,' I answered.
sentences.cn: 我回答道：“我知道其中的一些。”

sentences.en: Nancy felt surprised when I finally finished telling her all the names I knew.
sentences.cn: 当我终于跟她讲完所有我知道的星星的名字时，她感到很惊讶。

sentences.en: My interest in stars began when I was eight.
sentences.cn: 我对星星的兴趣始于我八岁那年。

sentences.en: My aunt Mrs Hill took me to a planetarium.
sentences.cn: 我的姨妈希尔夫人带我去了一家天文馆。

sentences.en: A guide showed us the groups of stars, and told us stories about how they got their names.
sentences.cn: 一位导游向我们展示了星群，并给我们讲了关于它们名字由来的故事。

sentences.en: The stories were wonderful.
sentences.cn: 那些故事很精彩。

sentences.en: I even saw some X-ray images of the stars there.
sentences.cn: 我甚至在那里看到了一些星星的X射线图。

sentences.en: It felt like standing in front of the gate of knowledge.
sentences.cn: 那感觉就像站在知识的大门前。

sentences.en: I took a course at the club to learn more about stars.
sentences.cn: 我在俱乐部参加了一门课程，来进一步了解星星。

sentences.en: I realised that in addition to clouds, a bright moon also stops us seeing stars clearly.
sentences.cn: 我意识到，除了云之外，明亮的月亮也会妨碍我们清楚地看到星星。

sentences.en: I always look for the Plough, because once I see that, I can find the North Star and other stars.
sentences.cn: 我总会寻找北斗七星，因为一旦我看到它，就能找到北极星和其他星星。

sentences.en: There are so many lights in the city that we have to go into the countryside to see any stars.
sentences.cn: 城市里的灯光太多了，以至于我们不得不去乡下才能看到星星。

sentences.en: I'm planning to make videos about stars in the countryside.
sentences.cn: 我正在计划拍摄一些乡村星空的视频。

sentences.en: I'll post them online for everyone to watch.
sentences.cn: 我会把它们发布到网上，供大家观看。

sentences.en: My greatest dream is to be an astronaut and I wish I could have a space travel.
sentences.cn: 我最大的梦想是成为一名航天员，并且希望我能有一次太空之旅。
